projects.title: Ping Pong
projects.description: Built a full-stack real-time ping pong game with user management, friend-based gameplay, and integrated chat using TypeScript, React, and Node.js with Fastify. Implemented OAuth 2.0 with JWT for secure authentication.

projects.title: WebServer
projects.description: Developed a high-performance HTTP server using C++ with non-blocking I/O and epoll/kqueue. Implemented request routing and static file serving for optimal performance.

projects.title: Inception
projects.description: Deployed a secure WordPress stack using Docker Compose, integrating NGINX, PHP-FPM, MariaDB, and Redis. Configured TLSv1.3 and Adminer, improving uptime significantly.

projects.title: Password Manager
projects.description: Developed a secure password storage application with React, Tailwind CSS, and Spring Boot. Used Spring Security and PostgreSQL for encrypted storage and authentication.
